items.docs:
**Deprecated.** Use the Open Endpoint *Lookup a referral code* instead.

Returns a referral code along with the referrer's name and the reward the code unlocks.

params.name: referral_code
params.description: The code to be validated, for example `BOBTESTERSON`. Can be a user's primary or non-primary referral code.

items.docs:
Returns a referral code along with the referrer's name and the reward the code unlocks. Use this from client-side contexts such as the Mobile and Web SDKs.

This is an [Open Endpoint](https://integrations.impact.com/impact-brand/reference/api-open-endpoints) and is disabled by default. Contact support to enable open endpoints.

params.name: code
params.description: The referral code to apply to the user's account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The account to apply the referral code to. This account will be marked as referred by the owner of the code.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user to apply the referral code to. This user will be marked as referred by the owner of the code.

items.docs:
Applies a referral code to the specified account and user, marking them as referred by the code's owner.

Requires a [write token](https://integrations.impact.com/impact-brand/reference/api-open-endpoints) or an API key. This is an [Open Endpoint](https://integrations.impact.com/impact-brand/reference/api-open-endpoints) and is disabled by default. Contact support to enable open endpoints.
